name: LLM-KICK
description: LLM-KICK is a benchmark suite designed to evaluate compressed large language models on knowledge-intensive tasks, assessing their language understanding, reasoning, generation, in-context retrieval, and summarization capabilities beyond traditional perplexity metrics.
reputation: A new benchmark suite for evaluating compressed LLMs on knowledge-intensive tasks, with emerging but not yet broad community adoption.
notes: Focuses on evaluating compressed LLMs' performance degradation and robustness; highlights limitations of pruning and quantization methods.
